title: Goldman Sachs upgrades Palantir stock rating to buy on AI growth
source_used: Yahoo Finance, with GuruFocus on TradingView
key_facts: Goldman Sachs analysts led by Gabriela Borges upgraded Palantir to Buy from Neutral with a 12-month price target of $230.
The target is about 18% above Wednesday's closing price.
Palantir shares rose about 2% on Thursday 8 Oct 2026 to close at $198.78, about 3% below the record high of $207.18 set on 3 Nov last year.
Goldman cited a shift to sovereign AI (governments wanting their own systems), custom applications and a new industry-by-industry strategy that may expand Palantir's market.
Goldman also said Palantir 'perfected' the feedback loop between its field engineers and its product team, and has a head start in using AI agents to scale it.
GuruFocus reported Goldman estimates Palantir is running at an $8 billion annual revenue pace with growth near 100%.
quote_evidence: Our primary takeaway from our most recent set of industry conversations is that the stock is setting up for another phase of outperformance into 2027,
Goldman's research team, led by Gabriela Borges, upgraded shares of Palantir to a Buy rating from Neutral, with a 12-month price target of $230.
why_it_matters_hint: A big bank has raised its view of a major AI software company, citing demand for government-controlled AI.
